environment: Linux x86_64; Clang 23.1.1, i686-pc-windows-msvc COFF, -O0/-O2; Unicorn 2.1.4 x86-32
reasoning: 4068 differential comparisons of reconstructed machine code with actual original x86 instructions. Return, cdecl stack, callee-saved registers and exact input reads checked. Synthetic epilogue tests preserve original arithmetic wrapping. Ready for independent review; no review record is asserted.

comparison.method: Emulate original bytes and reconstructed Windows x86 COFF in Unicorn; compare observable ABI/memory behavior
cases: 3042 scans: aligned, unaligned, guard-page placement, embedded terminators, surrogate units and 500 randomized inputs at two optimization levels
4 invalid input comparisons: null and no terminator
1022 synthetic arithmetic-tail comparisons: signed/unsigned/wrap boundaries and 500 randomized deltas per build

limitations: Function CPU emulation only; CONFIG.exe not reconstructed or run on Windows
Compiler and linker identity not recovered; source does not match original machine bytes
Very large strings simulated at arithmetic tail only
No MMIO, concurrent modification or alignment-check exception guarantees
